articles.title: Ahmedabad Gangster ‘Shooter AK 47’ Threatens to Jump, Nabbed by Cops
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A wanted criminal, Abhishek Tiwari (alias Shooter Tiwari), climbed onto the fifth-floor balcony of an apartment in Odhav, Ahmedabad, to evade arrest. He threatened to jump if approached, causing a standoff.

body.html:
A wanted criminal, Abhishek Tiwari (alias Shooter Tiwari), climbed onto the fifth-floor balcony of an apartment in Odhav, Ahmedabad, to evade arrest. He threatened to jump if approached, causing a standoff. Police and fire brigade teams arrived, and after three hours of negotiation, they safely brought him down. Tiwari was wanted in a kidnapping case under Krishnanagar police station. The incident was captured on video and went viral.

articles.title: Major Fire Engulfs Saharanpur Trade Fair, 25+ Shops Destroyed in Cylinder Blast
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A massive fire broke out at a trade fair in Saharanpur, Uttar Pradesh, destroying more than 25 shops after a suspected cylinder explosion triggered the blaze. The incident occurred during Bakrid when most shopkeepers had left their stalls to offer namaz prayers.

body.html:
A massive fire broke out at a trade fair in Saharanpur, Uttar Pradesh, destroying more than 25 shops after a suspected cylinder explosion triggered the blaze.

The incident occurred during Bakrid when most shopkeepers had left their stalls to offer namaz prayers. The timing potentially prevented a major tragedy, as crowds typically surge at the fair following prayer hours.

Fire department officials are investigating the cause of the cylinder explosion that reportedly sparked the widespread fire. The extent of property damage is being assessed as authorities work to contain the situation.

No casualties have been reported so far, with the absence of shopkeepers and reduced crowd presence during prayer time contributing to avoiding potential loss of life.

Local authorities are coordinating relief efforts for affected traders whose shops were destroyed in the fire.

articles.title: Fake GST Inspector Busted: Shahzad Fooled Entire Town to Marry Ikra – Now Headed to Jail!
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: This is Shahzad. He has completed his B.Com. He loves Ikra, who lives in the neighborhood. Ikra’s family had one condition for marriage — the groom must have a government job. Shahzad began preparing for the CGL and UP Police Sub-Inspector exams through YouTube.

body.html:
This is Shahzad. He has completed his B.Com. He loves Ikra, who lives in the neighborhood. Ikra’s family had one condition for marriage — the groom must have a government job. Shahzad began preparing for the CGL and UP Police Sub-Inspector exams through YouTube. He appeared for the exam but didn’t make the cut.

In the CGL list, at number 2643, there was a name: Shahzad Ansari. Seeing the name match, Shahzad distributed sweets, claiming he had been selected as a GST Inspector. He even gave interviews to the media. After that, he bought a police uniform and had a fake inspector ID card made.

Eventually, the so-called inspector convinced Ikra’s family, and they got married last year. But when Shahzad didn’t go to work and money started running short at home, the truth came out. Today, Shahzad is headed to jail from Bareilly, Uttar Pradesh.

articles.title: Horror in Bijnor: 5-Year-Old Girl Mauled to Death by Stray Dogs While Holding Mother's Hand!
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Bijnor, Uttar Pradesh — A heart-wrenching tragedy unfolded in Faizi Colony of Afzalgarh police station area, where a 5-year-old girl was mauled to death by a pack of stray dogs.

body.html:
Bijnor, Uttar Pradesh — A heart-wrenching tragedy unfolded in Faizi Colony of Afzalgarh police station area, where a 5-year-old girl was mauled to death by a pack of stray dogs. The incident has sparked panic among local residents and raised serious concerns about the stray dog menace in the area.

According to reports, a woman named Gulshan was returning home from the market with her daughter after buying milk. As they approached their residence, a group of stray dogs suddenly attacked. Despite the mother’s desperate attempts to save her daughter, the dogs fatally mauled the child.

The girl, identified as Sadf, succumbed to her injuries on the spot. The gruesome incident has left the family devastated and the community in shock. Residents of the area have expressed anger over the growing number of stray dogs and the lack of preventive action by authorities.

Local police have taken note of the incident. Meanwhile, there is growing demand for urgent action from the municipal authorities to control the stray dog population and ensure the safety of children and residents.

articles.title: Love Knows No Age: 95-Year-Old Man Marries His 90-Year-Old Partner After 70 Years Together!
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Dungarpur, Rajasthan — In a heartwarming and emotional event, a unique wedding in Galandar village of Rajasthan's Dungarpur district has captured the attention of many and delivered a powerful message to society: Love has no expiry date.

body.html:
Dungarpur, Rajasthan — In a heartwarming and emotional event, a unique wedding in Galandar village of Rajasthan's Dungarpur district has captured the attention of many and delivered a powerful message to society: Love has no expiry date.

After spending 70 years in a live-in relationship, 95-year-old Rama Bhai Angari and 90-year-old Jeevli Devi finally tied the knot in a traditional ceremony. Their journey, marked by unwavering companionship and mutual support, culminated in a celebration that moved not only their family but the entire village.

The couple began living together decades ago when formal marriage seemed out of reach. Over the years, they built a strong family of eight children—four sons and four daughters—many of whom are now employed in government services. Today, their joint family is known and respected in the village.

Recently, the elderly couple expressed their long-held wish to formalize their relationship through marriage. Their children wholeheartedly supported their decision and organized a full-fledged wedding to honor their parents' love and resilience.

On June 1, traditional pre-wedding rituals such as Haldi and Lagna were performed with community participation. The celebration included a Bindori procession with music, dance, and joy that lit up the entire village.

On the wedding day, under a flower-decked canopy, Rama Bhai and Jeevli Devi took the sacred seven vows, holding hands and pledging once more to stay together in love and faith.

This extraordinary wedding has now become an inspiration not only for Galandar but for society at large—proving that age is no barrier when hearts are united.

articles.title: Brave Dog Mini Fights Deadly Russell Viper to Save Boy in Meerut — Dies After 27-Hour Battle!
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Meerut, Uttar Pradesh — A courageous act of loyalty and sacrifice unfolded in Daurala area of Meerut, where a pet dog saved the life of its owner's son by fighting off a venomous Russell Viper snake, ultimately succumbing to multiple snake bites after a 27-hour struggle for survival.

body.html:
Meerut, Uttar Pradesh — A courageous act of loyalty and sacrifice unfolded in Daurala area of Meerut, where a pet dog saved the life of its owner's son by fighting off a venomous Russell Viper snake, ultimately succumbing to multiple snake bites after a 27-hour struggle for survival.

The incident took place on the intervening night of June 3–4 at the home of farmer Ajay Kumar alias Kallu, a resident of Mohalla Rampuri. According to the family, their 5-year-old American Bull dog, Mini, noticed the viper approaching the bed of Ajay’s 23-year-old son Vansh, who was sleeping in the gallery with other family members.

Mini fearlessly intercepted the snake and engaged it in a fight, sustaining 26 bites in the process. Vansh woke up to the sound of Mini's frantic barking and witnessed the dog grappling with the snake to keep it away from his bed. Though bitten repeatedly, Mini managed to push the viper away.

The family eventually captured the snake after a struggle and later released it into the nearby forest. Mini was rushed to Modipuram Veterinary Hospital and later received treatment from a Ghaziabad-based vet. Despite efforts to save her, she passed away after 27 hours.

Mini had been with the family since she was less than a month old and was considered a beloved member. Grieving her loss, the family has brought home a new pup, naming her Mini in memory of their brave dog.

Forest Department DFO Rajesh Kumar confirmed, based on photos, that the snake was a Russell Viper, a highly venomous and aggressive species found in the Sardhana range area. Its bite contains amotoxin that causes rapid blood clotting and can result in death within an hour if untreated.
